timeline.summary: The renegades attack the Aether Hub and begin a revolt; the Consulate diverts the Gatewatch with Baral and Dovin Baan and retakes the hub.
timeline.quote: the Consulate retook control of the Aether Hub

timeline.summary: Captain Baral's troops burned Burarat, killing Kiran, taking Chandra to be executed and jailing Pia.
timeline.quote: Kiran was killed, Chandra was taken away to be executed and Pia was jailed.
